integrity: The proof is self-contained and uses exact algebra. Symbolic identities and a rational numerical grid were reproduced using the included checker, but the grid is not substituted for the all-size proof. A separately published supplementary text was not obtained, leaving a residual literature risk.
scientific_limitations: The complete classification concerns \(X\sim\operatorname{Bin}(n,p)\), with \(n\ge1\), \(0<p<1\), and \(Y=\lfloor2X/3\rfloor\), under ordinary log-concavity. It makes no claim for heterogeneous parameters, other rational quantizations, success probabilities at the endpoints, strong-Rayleigh properties, or general stochastic-ordering theorems.
title: Sharp log-concavity windows for two-thirds binomial quantization
